n3b61d4937d.headline: Budget revenues through customs exceeded AZN 6.6 billion over last year
n3b61d4937d.summary: Azerbaijan's customs-line budget revenue reached about AZN 6.65 billion in 2024, up 4.9% from the previous year, according to the State Customs Committee.
n3b61d4937d.why: Customs receipts are a major source of government revenue for Azerbaijan, an oil-exporting economy whose budget depends heavily on energy income.

nf88781f593.headline: Nigeria recorded over 589 oil spills in 2024, most caused by oil theft
nf88781f593.summary: Nigeria recorded at least 589 oil spills in 2024, according to satellite-tracker data, with most attributed to oil theft.
nf88781f593.why: Oil spills and theft reduce output and raise remediation and security costs for producers operating in the Niger Delta.

nb07a87da45.headline: Azerbaijan produced AZN 38 bln. worth of oil and gas in 2024
nb07a87da45.summary: The total value of Azerbaijan's mining-industry production, which is dominated by oil and gas, was reported for 2024. The source gives an output figure of AZN 38 billion for oil and gas.
nb07a87da45.why: Azerbaijan is a hydrocarbon exporter, so the value of its oil and gas output shapes its fiscal revenue and export earnings.

n1e7d54d308.headline: Two Dollars For The Price Of One In Barbados, But No US Dollar Coins Accepted.
n1e7d54d308.summary: The Central Bank of Barbados said businesses are not required to accept US$1 notes and encouraged exchanging them at commercial banks. It reminded the public that the Barbadian dollar is the legal tender.
n1e7d54d308.why: The central bank issues and manages Barbados's currency, which is pegged to the US dollar.

n55bdfe1537.headline: Regulator accuses drug middlemen of wild price hikes, possibly steering business to themselves
n55bdfe1537.summary: The Federal Trade Commission's interim report says powerful drug middlemen marked up drugs for cancer, AIDS and multiple sclerosis far over prevailing prices. The report raises questions about whether they steered business to themselves.
n55bdfe1537.why: Pharmacy benefit managers (PBMs) are intermediaries between drugmakers, insurers and pharmacies, and their pricing practices are a recurring target of US regulators and lawmakers.

ndc8e0bf410.headline: PM: The BSSC project is a major factor to Europe’s energy security
ndc8e0bf410.summary: Azerbaijan's Prime Minister Ali Asadov said megaprojects with Georgia are a major factor in Europe's energy security. He spoke at the 10th session of the Georgia-Azerbaijan Intergovernmental Commission on Economic Cooperation.
ndc8e0bf410.why: Azerbaijan is a Caspian gas and oil producer, and South Caucasus pipeline and energy projects shape European supply diversification away from Russian energy.

nd867d57e99.headline: Edison starts partnership for mini reactors in factories
nd867d57e99.summary: Edison, EDF and Enea have signed an agreement on small modular nuclear reactors to provide decarbonized power to industrial districts. The partnership was reported from Italy.
nd867d57e99.why: Edison is an Italian energy company, and small modular reactors are a emerging low-carbon power technology that could supply industrial electricity demand.

n26f253dba2.headline: Niger Delta youths laud Tinubu for advancing tax reform bill
n26f253dba2.summary: A coalition of Niger Delta youth stakeholders commended President Bola Tinubu for advancing the Tax Reform Bill. The bill is progressing through the Nigerian political process.
n26f253dba2.why: Tax reform in Nigeria affects government revenue, business tax burdens and investor confidence in Africa's largest economy by GDP.

na7439d4c5b.headline: ZSE poised for growth in 2025
na7439d4c5b.summary: The ZSE All-Share Index dropped 17.9%, driven by significant losses in the Top 15 and Top 10 indices, according to Fincent Securities. The report looked ahead to growth prospects for 2025.
na7439d4c5b.why: The Zimbabwe Stock Exchange is the country's main equity market, and its index tracks the largest listed companies that investors use to gauge local market conditions.
na7439d4c5b.why_moved: The decline was driven by significant losses in the Top 15 and Top 10 indices, according to Fincent Securities.

n43fa1cbc33.headline: Government update on £170 Licence Fee as BBC chairman says it could be replaced
n43fa1cbc33.summary: The government has provided an update on the £170 licence fee, and BBC chairman Samir Shah said reforming, replacing or creating a new funding mechanism are all options.
n43fa1cbc33.why: The BBC is funded largely by the licence fee, so changes to this mechanism affect its revenue and the UK media market.

n33fc1d0fec.headline: Only 15% of approved capital budget released for health sector – Pate
n33fc1d0fec.summary: Health Minister Mohammed Ali Pate said only N26.552 billion of N233.656 billion approved for health capital projects in the 2024 Appropriation Act has been released. He expressed displeasure in Abuja.
n33fc1d0fec.why: Capital budget releases determine how much public investment reaches infrastructure, and slow releases affect fiscal execution in Nigeria.

n195fb86c7f.headline: Millions of UK households face mobile phone and broadband rule change on Friday
n195fb86c7f.summary: Ofcom will enforce a ban on mid-contract telecoms price rises from Friday, January 17, the regulator has said. The rule targets what it calls nasty surprises for customers.
n195fb86c7f.why: Ofcom is the UK communications regulator, and its rules shape pricing and competition among mobile and broadband providers. Restrictions on mid-contract price rises affect telecom firms' revenue models.

n8fa1d3297b.headline: PETAN tasks govt on consideration for local contractors in divested assets
n8fa1d3297b.summary: The Petroleum Technology Association of Nigeria called on the government to uphold Section 3.3 of the Local Content Act 2010 and give local contractors first consideration in divested assets. The call was made in Abuja.
n8fa1d3297b.why: Divestments of oil and gas assets change which companies operate and supply Nigeria's upstream sector, and local content rules shape who wins that work.

n93f22b277f.headline: Experts weigh impact of Trump on Australian economy
n93f22b277f.summary: Experts weigh how Donald Trump's policies will affect Australia's economy. One says a weaker China translates to a weaker Australia, while another says his pro-growth policies could help.
n93f22b277f.why: China is Australia's largest trading partner, so changes in Chinese demand feed directly into Australian exports, growth and the Australian dollar.

n5eff1dd6e3.headline: Housing prices surge despite record supply | The Jerusalem Post
n5eff1dd6e3.summary: Israeli housing prices rose 0.6% in late 2024, led by new apartments despite record supply. Tel Aviv posted the highest monthly increase at 1.2%, while Haifa had the top annual gain at 11.7%.
n5eff1dd6e3.why: Housing prices feed into Israel's inflation, household wealth and construction activity, which matter for the central bank's rate decisions and local real estate investors.

n7f53812e29.headline: EMEA Morning Briefing :  Futures Up as Gaza Cease-Fire Deal Reached
n7f53812e29.summary: European stock futures were higher after a Gaza cease-fire deal was reached, while Asian stocks were mixed. Traders were watching UK retail sales and eurozone CPI.
n7f53812e29.why: Stock index futures show expected opening moves for European equity markets, and geopolitical de-escalation in the Middle East can affect risk sentiment and energy prices.
n7f53812e29.why_moved: European stock futures rose after a Gaza cease-fire deal was reached, per the market briefing, reducing geopolitical risk sentiment.

ne54fad8c1f.headline: Leading furniture retailer warns of Budget-driven price hikes in 2025
ne54fad8c1f.summary: A leading furniture retailer warned of price hikes in 2025 driven by the Budget. It cited rising costs and economic challenges shaping retailers this year.
ne54fad8c1f.why: Furniture retailers are exposed to consumer demand and input costs, so changes to UK tax and budget policy can feed into retail prices.

n82f5b12467.headline: EU-Defizitverfahren gegen Österreich abgewendet
n82f5b12467.summary: Austrian Finance Minister Gunter Mayr was informed in a letter from EU Commissioner Valdis Dombrovskis that the EU will not open a deficit procedure against Austria.
n82f5b12467.why: Excessive deficit procedures are EU fiscal enforcement tools that can constrain national budgets and affect the cost of government borrowing.

n241e43bd0b.headline: EvoAir :  Quarterly Report for Quarter Ending November 30, 2024 (Form 10-Q)
n241e43bd0b.summary: State pensioners have been warned the triple lock could be axed and replaced by a single lock, after Torsten Bell was appointed pensions minister by Prime Minister Keir Starmer.
n241e43bd0b.why: The triple lock sets annual state pension increases at the highest of inflation, wage growth or 2.5%, so changes to it affect public spending and pension costs.

n5b054054f8.headline: Mark Carney launches leadership bid, comes out swinging against Pierre Poilievre
n5b054054f8.summary: Former Bank of Canada governor Mark Carney launched his bid to replace Justin Trudeau as leader, calling Conservative leader Pierre Poilievre a dangerous, sloganeering populist.
n5b054054f8.why: The leadership of the governing party determines Canada's prime minister and therefore the direction of fiscal, trade and economic policy. Carney's central banking background is relevant to markets.

n230b39c212.headline: Shares at PSX climb 1,400 points on easing political concerns
n230b39c212.summary: Shares on the Pakistan Stock Exchange climbed 1,400 points as the market responded positively to a verdict in a graft case, according to an analyst cited by Dawn.
n230b39c212.why: The Pakistan Stock Exchange is the country's main equity market, and political developments can quickly shift investor sentiment toward Pakistani assets.
n230b39c212.why_moved: The article attributes the rally to the market responding positively to a graft case verdict, which an analyst said eased political concerns.

nde772af1f2.headline: India’ growth poised to rebound: RBI
nde772af1f2.summary: The Reserve Bank of India said India's growth is poised to rebound, with rural demand continuing to gain momentum and reflecting resilience in consumption.
nde772af1f2.why: The Reserve Bank of India sets monetary policy, and its growth assessment informs views on interest rates, corporate earnings and Indian equities and bonds.

nf42a0133a2.headline: Honda wants Renault to move out before Nissan moves in – report
nf42a0133a2.summary: A report says Honda wants Nissan to buy out the share Renault holds in it, before the two Japanese brands proceed further. Details beyond the headline were not provided.
nf42a0133a2.why: Honda and Nissan are major Japanese automakers, and Renault holds a stake in Nissan, so shareholding changes affect the alliance's structure and value.

nfcd07e97f8.headline: Year-on-year weekly inflation increases by 1.16%
nfcd07e97f8.summary: The Sensitive Price Indicator for the week ending January 16 recorded a year-on-year increase of 1.16%, the lowest rate in many months. It further eases inflation pressures.
nfcd07e97f8.why: The Sensitive Price Indicator tracks weekly prices of essential goods in Pakistan, offering an early read on inflation that shapes central bank policy.

nfc6f108336.headline: EU to support Nigeria, other sub-Saharan African countries with €510m
nfc6f108336.summary: The European Commission said it will support Nigeria and other sub-Saharan African countries with €510 million. The EU has budgeted €1.9 billion for humanitarian assistance worldwide.
nfc6f108336.why: EU development and humanitarian funding flows to African governments and aid programmes, influencing public spending in recipient countries.

n7d50b8de86.headline: AUCyber revenue falls short due to challenging times
n7d50b8de86.summary: ASX-listed AUCyber reported revenues in cyber security, cloud and managed services below expectations, with a six-month EBITDA loss of $1.6 million on $12.2 million revenue. It has paused its CEO search.
n7d50b8de86.why: AUCyber is a small ASX-listed cyber and cloud services provider, and its results and leadership changes matter to its shareholders.

n605028cf01.headline: Aussie Broadband's Phillip Britt retires
n605028cf01.summary: Aussie Broadband's group managing director, Phillip Britt, will retire on 28 February 2025. He will take a newly created special technical advisor role supporting the expanding fibre network.
n605028cf01.why: Aussie Broadband is an ASX-listed telecommunications provider, and leadership transitions can affect strategy and investor confidence.

neac44dcd1e.headline: US auto safety regulator closes probe into nearly 7,000 Fisker electric SUVs
neac44dcd1e.summary: The U.S. auto safety regulator closed its probe into 6,971 Fisker Ocean SUVs on Friday over inadvertent activation of automatic emergency braking. It does not expect further action.
neac44dcd1e.why: Fisker was a US electric vehicle maker, and safety probes by the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration can lead to recalls that affect automaker costs and reputation.

ne6b8cd29ee.headline: Future of mobility belongs to India: PM Modi
ne6b8cd29ee.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi said the mobility sector attracted $36 billion in foreign direct investment in four years. He also paid tribute to Ratan Tata and Suzuki.
ne6b8cd29ee.why: Foreign direct investment in automotive and mobility sectors shows the flow of capital into India's manufacturing base and its growing vehicle market.

nebe590dc97.headline: Tanker Under US Sanctions Discharges Oil at Chinese Port: LSEG Data
nebe590dc97.summary: A tanker subject to new US sanctions is discharging Russian oil at a port operated by Shandong Port Group in east China, according to LSEG shipping data. The vessel is named under the new sanctions regime.
nebe590dc97.why: Sanctions on tankers carrying Russian crude affect global oil flows, freight costs and buyers in China, a major crude importer.

n5cc9dcede3.headline: Four injured in explosion, fire at oil refinery in southern Germany
n5cc9dcede3.summary: Four people were injured after an explosion caused a fire at an oil refinery in Neustadt an der Donau, north of Munich, police said. The incident was reported on Friday.
n5cc9dcede3.why: Refineries convert crude into fuels and feedstocks, so outages in Germany can affect regional fuel supply and prices.

n6d2b050ac0.headline: IMF retains India's FY25 growth forecast at 6.5% - Times of India
n6d2b050ac0.summary: The IMF maintained its 2024-25 growth forecast for India at 6.5%. It noted a sharper-than-expected deceleration in industrial activity and called for measures.
n6d2b050ac0.why: The IMF is the International Monetary Fund, which publishes global economic forecasts. India is one of the largest emerging economies, so its growth outlook matters for global investors.

ned3b71e5ba.headline: US Treasury secretary Janet Yellen's computer hacked: 'Doubt she knows how to reboot WiFi,' mocks Musk
ned3b71e5ba.summary: Chinese state-sponsored hackers breached the US Treasury Department and accessed unclassified files on computers of top officials, including Secretary Janet Yellen.
ned3b71e5ba.why: The US Treasury manages federal finances and issues US government debt. Cyber intrusions into financial agencies raise concerns about national security and market confidence.

n5d72058f58.headline: Mass deportations could leave a hole in the West’s service and agriculture economies
n5d72058f58.summary: Immigrants without legal status make up a large part of the workforce in several Mountain West industries. They have a combined household income of almost $27 billion in the region.
n5d72058f58.why: Service and agriculture sectors rely heavily on immigrant labor, and labor shortages can raise costs and reduce output. Immigration policy is therefore an economic variable for these industries.

nc1c97403d1.headline: 'Never expected he will run for Canadian Prime Ministership,' says Indian-origin MP Chandra Arya's father | India News
nc1c97403d1.summary: Chandra Arya, MP for Nepean in Ottawa, has announced his candidacy for Canadian prime minister following Justin Trudeau's resignation. His father said he never expected the move.
nc1c97403d1.why: Justin Trudeau's resignation opens a leadership contest for Canada's governing party. Leadership changes can shift policy expectations on fiscal, trade and energy matters.

n57539668b9.headline: Startups, venture capital firms seek tax benefits | India News
n57539668b9.summary: Startups and venture capital firms are seeking a simplified tax regime and measures to boost domestic capital availability in the upcoming Indian Budget.
n57539668b9.why: Tax treatment of startups and venture funds influences how much capital flows into early-stage companies.

n9677da79e2.headline: Investor interest spans across short to mid end maturities - Breaking News | Daily Mirror
n9677da79e2.summary: Sri Lanka's secondary market yield curve saw buying interest in short and mid maturities, with mixed trading activity. The report covers local government debt trading.
n9677da79e2.why: Government bond yields set the benchmark cost of borrowing in Sri Lanka and signal investor appetite for local debt.

n27fa8a6354.headline: Netel to sell its operations in Finland - releases figures for 2024
n27fa8a6354.summary: Infrastructure company Netel is starting a process to sell its Finnish operations, according to a press release. The Finnish business has for several years had a profit margin below the group level.
n27fa8a6354.why: Netel is an infrastructure services company, and divestments reshape its portfolio and profitability. Shareholders and creditors track such disposals for their effect on earnings.

n554542751f.headline: Austria is set for a far-right chancellor. For the EU it’s the ‘new normal’
n554542751f.summary: If Herbert Kickl becomes chancellor, Austria would join a list of disruptive EU member states, putting EU policies in peril, the Guardian reports.
n554542751f.why: Austria is an EU member, and its government position affects bloc-wide decisions on budgets, sanctions and fiscal rules. Political instability in member states can weigh on European assets.

nc88ecda8c0.headline: UAE rolls over $2 billion loan to Pakistan
nc88ecda8c0.summary: Pakistan's central bank said the UAE confirmed rollover of two $1 billion deposits placed with State Bank of Pakistan for another year. The report cites Reuters.
nc88ecda8c0.why: Deposits from foreign governments support Pakistan's foreign-exchange reserves, which matter for its currency and external financing. Rollovers reduce near-term repayment pressure.

nb0c1eef1a7.headline: Stock market today: Wall Street finishes its best week since Trump's election with a rally
nb0c1eef1a7.summary: U.S. stock indexes rallied to close out their best week in two months, according to the report.
nb0c1eef1a7.why: The S&P 500 tracks 500 large US companies and is the main barometer of US equity market performance.
nb0c1eef1a7.why_moved: U.S. stock indexes rallied to close out their best week in two months, according to the report.

nb8b707f653.headline: Indonesia Officially Implements 15 percent Global Minimum Tax
nb8b707f653.summary: Indonesia's Ministry of Finance has implemented a 15 percent global minimum tax, effective from 2025, aimed at reducing unhealthy tax rate competition.
nb8b707f653.why: The global minimum corporate tax, set under an OECD framework, affects how multinationals are taxed where they operate and reduces incentives for tax-rate competition.

nde065d6aa8.headline: Today Currency Exchange Rates in Pakistan – 17 January 2025
nde065d6aa8.summary: Pakistani rupee rates against the US dollar, euro, pound, riyal and dirham changed on January 17, 2025 in the open market, with 1 USD at 279.1 rupees on Friday.
nde065d6aa8.why: Exchange rates affect import costs, remittance values and inflation in Pakistan, where the rupee is quoted against major currencies.

impacts.name: Pakistani rupee
impacts.why: Open-market rates against the dollar and other currencies changed on the day.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

n8133801180.headline: Dusit International signs new hotels in Mindanao | TTG Asia
n8133801180.summary: Dusit International signed hotel management agreements with IDC Prime for two new hotels in Northern Mindanao under its Dusit Princess brand. Both are set to open in late 2029.
n8133801180.why: Dusit International is a Thailand-based hotel group that expands through management contracts, which add fee income without large capital outlays.

n3566e84938.headline: Impact of Trump tariffs on Metro Vancouver real estate likely short-lived: report
n3566e84938.summary: A Greater Vancouver Realtors forecast says the impact of possible US tariffs on the residential market would likely be short-lived.
n3566e84938.why: Housing sales and prices in Vancouver shape household wealth, mortgage lending and the Canadian real estate sector.

n7e2d6398e1.headline: Mark Carney launches leadership bid, comes out swinging against Pierre Poilievre
n7e2d6398e1.summary: Former Bank of Canada governor Mark Carney officially launched his bid to lead the Liberal Party on Thursday. He criticised Conservative leader Pierre Poilievre as a dangerous, sloganeering populist.
n7e2d6398e1.why: Mark Carney previously led the Bank of Canada and the Bank of England, and his policy stance matters to markets watching Canadian fiscal and monetary direction.

nd7d871faf9.headline: U.S. tariffs could become catalyst to bolster Canadian food supply chains: experts
nd7d871faf9.summary: Experts say U.S. tariffs on Canadian goods could accelerate efforts to expand domestic food processing and manufacturing, even as some companies consider moving operations south.
nd7d871faf9.why: Canada's food processing sector supplies domestic and export markets, and trade barriers can shift where companies choose to locate production.
